# fundament_cluster (Data Source)

Fetches a single Kubernetes cluster by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fundament_cluster" "example" {
  name = "my-cluster"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the cluster to look up.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the cluster.
- `kubernetes_version` (String) The Kubernetes version of the cluster.
- `region` (String) The region where the cluster is deployed.
- `status` (String) The current status of the cluster.
